name: context-mode
description: Context window optimization for AI coding agents. Sandboxes tool output (98% reduction), persists session memory, and enforces routing across 17 platforms via MCP + hooks.
one_liner: A plumbing tool that stops AI coding assistants from drowning in their own output, so they stay fast and don't forget what you were doing.
buyer: An engineering lead at a company where developers use AI coding agents all day and are frustrated the agent 'forgets' context mid-task and slows down.
business_use_cases: An engineering org with 50+ developers on AI coding agents rolls it out company-wide so agents stop burning budget on redundant context and compacting mid-task.
A dev-tools startup bundles it into their own AI coding product so customers get longer, cheaper agent sessions without building the optimization themselves.
A consultancy that bills clients for AI-assisted development uses it to cut their own token spend across every engagement.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a hosted/managed version with team dashboards and usage analytics for engineering managers.
License it to AI coding tool vendors as an embedded context-management layer.

steal_this: This is infrastructure for developers, not a standalone product; the fastest real move is contributing an integration for a platform it doesn't yet support and building reputation in that niche, not starting a business on top of it.
